title: MapImage
description:
A picture of a worldspace from above, made from the terrain textures in
the user's own game, for drawing the map on.

columns.description: How many cell columns it shows.

image.description: The picture, a PNG as a `data:` address. Its top row is the north.

rows.description: How many cell rows it shows.

south.description: The southmost cell row it shows.

west.description: The westmost cell column it shows.
